<?php
class Fruit {
    private string $name;
    private string $color;

    public function __construct(string $name, string $color) {
        $this->name  = $name;
        $this->color = $color;
    }

    public function intro(): void {
        echo "{$this->name} is {$this->color}";
    }
}

$apple = new Fruit('Apple', 'red');
$apple->intro();

<?php
// Avant PHP 8
class Fruit {
    private string $name;
    private string $color;
    public function __construct(string $n, string $c) {
        $this->name = $n;
        $this->color = $c;
    }
}

// Depuis PHP 8
class Fruit {
    public function __construct(
        private string $name,
        private string $color
    ) {}
}

<?php
class Fruit {
    public function __construct(public string $name) {
        echo "Cree: {$this->name}\n";
    }
    public function __destruct() {
        echo "Detruit: {$this->name}\n";
    }
}
